entities.name: tracker on the far-bank path (the rear man of the file)
entities.what: Tracker (纤夫), the rear man of the file, the tow line made fast to him at about (16325, 112): a small working man in short clothes (dress not legible at this size), bent far forward and leaning east as he hauls, walking east-north-east up the far-bank path with the others in single file.
entities.src: 名画记: 河边泊船 (纤夫) (pin 25)
entities.note: Painted 32 px tall (head 97, feet 128-130). The line comes in from the west, from the masted boat's mast top (about (16080, 33), river_w's boat at 15950-16220), and ends at his west side at waist height. The path rises east from (16320, 130) to (16435, 75), dv/du about -0.5. The restyle paints six trackers, one with a big hat or bundle; the scan has five.

entities.name: man at the railing of the hall's east gallery
entities.what: Man in a cap and a light robe in the first bay of the riverside hall's east side gallery, face turned toward the viewer and a little west, arms forward on a cross-bar (a rail or a table edge) at chest height, perhaps holding a cup: a customer looking out from the gallery.
entities.vis: part: below the waist hidden by the gallery's railing
entities.note: Head 1270-1290, shoulders 1292, cross-bar 1322-1328, robe front to about 1352, then the diagonal railing. Standing or seated at a table is unclear; foot est from a standing figure's height (about 95 px). UPPER FLOOR: the side gallery's floor is hidden; the railing's bottom rail runs (16335, 1460) -> (16480, 1350) in front of him, so his floor point lies above that line. The support's building ID is structures_w's hall entity. The restyle paints two figures here in different poses. If structures_w reads the hall as 十千脚店's riverside wing, src 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting) applies.

entities.name: second figure in the gallery bay (faint)
entities.what: Faint rounded shape just east of the man at the gallery railing, read as a second customer seen from behind with his shoulder turned toward the first; it may instead be a curtain or a hanging cloth in the bay.
entities.vis: part: only the shoulder and back show between the posts
entities.note: Rounded outline u 16370-16395, v 1280-1310, bounded east by the bay's post at u 16395. Both readings: a second figure (the restyle paints two men here) or a hanging cloth. Foot est at the same floor as the man beside him.

entities.name: small figure at the far-bank shop's platform (faint)
entities.what: Tiny tinted upright mark at the foot of the far-bank shop's platform, west of its front: possibly a small figure standing or crouching on the bank; it may be a stone or a post of the row along the platform.
entities.note: Mark u 16715-16730, v 202-222, about 20 px tall with a faint pink tint, while the trackers 100 px higher on the silk are about 32 px: too small for a standing adult unless crouching. Both readings: a crouching figure (the restyle paints a figure among round jars here) or one of the posts of the far house's terrace rail (S3.bld.far_house_16560; t2's row prop was retired as that rail at the merge).

entities.name: small figure under the far-bank shop's front (faint)
entities.what: Tiny tinted upright mark under the far-bank shop's open front: possibly a small figure standing on the bank below the platform; it may be a post of the platform.
entities.note: Mark u 16817-16830, v 205-226, about 21 px tall, faint pink tint, taller than the ticks of the row around it. Both readings: a figure (the restyle paints a standing man here) or a post of the platform.

entities.name: willow on the far bank behind the moored boat (west)
entities.what: Willow on the far bank behind the long moored boat: a trunk leaning west from the bank to a knobby pollard head at about (16485, 126), from which long, thin, leafless whips fan out in every direction up to the top of the silk.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind the moored boat's cabin roof
entities.note: The whips converge low at about (16572-16588, 224-248), where the foot is put at the bank edge just above the boat's roof. The restyle (usable here) draws this trunk at about 16590 leaning west. It also draws a small extra tree at about (16485, 212) and a bird at (16440, 220) that the scan doesn't show. Second pass: t2's 'small roof-like form under the west far willow (16465-16540, v 115-135)' is this willow's pollard head: a dark wedge at u 16468-16500, v 116-132 from which the whips radiate and down to which the leaning trunk's two outlines run from the foot (16572, 236). No shed (crops c_farwillow.jpg, insp_farwillow.jpg).

entities.name: willow on the far bank behind the moored boat (east)
entities.what: Second willow on the far bank, east of the first: a trunk seen at u 16655-16668 (v 160-235) leaning west near its top to a pollard head at about (16612, 128), its leafless whips fanning up and out between the first willow and the shop to the east.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind the moored boat's cabin roof
entities.note: The crowns of the two far willows overlap; which head belongs to which trunk is read from the trunks' lean (the restyle draws both trunks leaning west). The shop's roof (u 16540-16820, v 15-55) shows behind the whips.

entities.name: spiky shrub at the foot of the far-bank wall
entities.what: Low clump of long pointed leaves or stiff stems (like a clump of tall grass or young bamboo) at the foot of the walled building east of the far-bank shop.
entities.note: Clump u 16887-16947, v 167-200. The tile restyle paints stacked stones and two seated figures here; the scan shows only the spiky clump.

entities.name: big bare tree behind the hall's east gable
entities.what: Large bare tree with stiff, crooked, forking branches (elm-like, no leaves) standing behind the riverside hall's east gable; its trunk leans east toward its foot and its crown spreads west over the water and the hall roof.
entities.vis: part: the trunk below v 930 and its foot hidden behind the hall's roof
entities.note: Trunk seen from the main fork (16385, 800) to (16430, 892), heading for the hall's ridge just east of the gable ornament (16408, 932); foot est on that line about 50 px below the ridge. The crown reaches into t1's range (to u 16120). The restyle turns it into a willow.

entities.name: big bare tree between the hall and 十千脚店
entities.what: Large bare tree between the riverside hall's east gallery and 十千脚店's roof: a straight trunk dividing at a dark knot into many long, thin, upright twigs, with long fine strands hanging down in front of the tavern's west roof.
entities.vis: part: the foot hidden behind the hall's east gallery roof
entities.note: Trunk seen at u 16567-16590 from v 840 to the knot at (16572, 990), then faintly down-west to (16553, 1047). The foot is est on that line where the gallery roof (about u 16355-16540, v 1100-1240) hides it. Fine strands hang to v 1190 over u 16490-16730. They may be a pollarded willow's whips before leafing; the restyle paints it as a willow-like tree whose trunk leans down to about (16480, 1150). Second pass: the upright shoots behind the riverside hall's east gable (u 16427-16530, v 860-1100; t1's 'upright shoots', left to t2) are this tree's: they fan up from about (16530-16550, 1100-1125), on the line of this trunk below the knot and about 20 px north-east of the base est (16520, 1150); no other trunk or stool shows (crops c_gableshoots.jpg, c_gableshoots2.jpg, c_gableshoots3.jpg, insp_gableshoots.jpg; the restyle paints them as this tree's lower branches too). No new tree.

entities.name: bare tree at the bottom edge before the hall's east end
entities.what: Bare tree at the silk's bottom edge in front of the hall's east end: two leaders spring from one foot at the bottom edge and fork into stiff, spreading twigs. Its east branch reaches over the edge of 十千脚店's roof.
entities.vis: part: foot at the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: The leaders meet at (16336-16348, 1768); the east leader forks at (16376, 1700). The stems rising from the bottom edge west of u 16300 are t1's.

entities.name: thin stems at the bottom edge
entities.what: A few thin straight stems (shoots, a sapling or a small thicket, no trunk shown) rising from the silk's bottom edge just east of the bare tree's foot.
entities.vis: part: foot at the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Stems at u 16388-16428 and fainter ones at 16460-16500, rising from v 1772 to about 1655-1700. They may be the bare tree's low twigs; they rise straight from the bottom edge, away from its leaders.
